What is Kartu briefing awak kabin?

Definition

Card summarising aircraft type-specific emergency duties used during crew pre-flight briefing.

Operational example

Purser advises cabin crew briefing card for rear jumpseat missing; request replacement document delivered to aircraft before final door close.
